_comment: Базовые параметры и шаблоны по умолчанию для всех вселенных

_trend_size_depender_modes.dyn_inv_16: (Bollinger Inverted 16) Контр-трендовый 4h Боллинджер, шкала 16 (коридор 33.3% / 66.7%), 4h-заморозка 50/50 при пробое.
_trend_size_depender_modes.dyn_ema_16: (EMA Trend 16) Трендовый фильтр Dual EMA 10/30 (4h), шкала 16 (коридор 33.3% / 66.7%).
_trend_size_depender_modes.dyn_ema_10: (EMA Trend 10) Трендовый фильтр Dual EMA 10/30 (4h), мягкая шкала 10 (коридор 40.0% / 60.0%).

fixed_net._desc: Mode 3: Direct flat basket take without trailing pullback. All positions liquidate to 100% cash when iter_net >= target_net_usdt.
fixed_net._desc_target_net_usdt: Fixed target net profit of iteration in USDT.
fixed_net._desc_scale_by_invest_size: If true, target scales as (invest_size / quant_reference_size) * target_net_usdt.

toxicity_adaptive._desc: Mode 2: Dynamic adaptive take based on inventory toxicity score. Liquidates basket on bounce to clean net profit.
toxicity_adaptive._desc_score_weights: Score method weights: margin load 35%, grid depth 30%, float loss ratio 25%, delta recovery 15%. Sum = 1.0.
toxicity_adaptive._desc_emergency_exit_floor_usdt: Minimum guaranteed profit on panic inventory (S >= 0.70). Loss close is prohibited.

trailing_ratchet._desc: Mode 1: Reacting skeleton. Pure Fibonacci ladder levels L0..L5. Triggers trailing stop and closes basket on pullback to floor.
